tasks.label: Inspect BuildMate App Ports
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5173,5080,8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Stop Old BuildMate Services
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5173,5080,8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "Stopped process $_" }
